Kim / Karthik — quick guidance after review:  

1) Credit memo path (preferred): For AWS we can request a credit memo / reversal via AWS Settlements referencing the original invoice number, but AWS requires: partner ID (we have REDWOOD-AMZ-9876), the marketplace invoice ids (INV-4521/4522), and confirmation from the reseller that they authorise the reversal. I’ll open the Settlements case and coordinate with Amy to confirm the SLA for reversal.

2) Tax docs: Signed W-9 + VAT registration evidence are fine for the reseller’s AP team to accept a vendor invoice. W-8BEN-E is only necessary if Redwood will assert a non-US withholding position for US-sourced fees; since the reseller and end-customer are UK-based and the charge was through AWS Marketplace, W-9 + VAT is sufficient for now. Karthik, please correct me if this is off.

3) Repurchase fallback: If AWS cannot issue the reversal in time, the fallback is a repurchase flow where ResellerCo issues a credit to their customer and we issue a new vendor invoice to ResellerCo or directly to the end-customer. This requires a new PO and may delay close of month.

Next steps I’ll take now: open AWS Settlements case referencing INV-4521/4522 and loop Amy; confirm expected turn time. Karthik please confirm the W-8/W-9 position in writing and whether legal needs to add anything to the invoice for UK VAT evidence.

-- Jordan Blake
